column1: # Czech (cs) catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty                a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code
#            @id                  a command id (e.g. file.saveAs): wins over the English text for
#                                 that menu item, so one id can read differently from its twin
#            @plural              `source` is "one|other" (English forms); the translation lists the
#            anything else        a disambiguating context passed to `tr_ctx`
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of the English labels, following common Czech desktop
# conventions (menus are nouns, commands are infinitives); not taken from Adobe Acrobat's Czech
# localisation or any other product's translation. Terminology: annotations are "komentáře",
# pages are "stránky", form fields are "formulářová pole", redaction is "začernění", flattening is
# "sloučení se stránkou", tags are "tagy" (to tag = "označkovat"). Product and format names
# (PdfCraft, PDF, PDF/A, OCR, XFA, Word, HTML…) stay in Latin letters; the trailing "…" of dialog
# commands is kept. Messages with a count but no `@plural` entry use count-neutral wording
# ("Vybráno stránek: {n}"), because Czech has three plural forms.
